tips.title: CSV schema

fields.nameSymbol: Required text. Wrap values containing commas in double quotes.
fields.assetType: One of Stocks, Crypto, Funds, Bonds, Cash.
fields.prices: USD per unit, 0 or more. $ and thousands commas are tolerated inside quotes.
fields.source: Optional label, e.g. which account it lives in.

tips.disclaimer: Imports are all-or-nothing: if any row fails validation, nothing is added. Rows append to existing holdings; nothing is overwritten.

insights.title: How balanced is it, really?
insights.description: A rules-based read of your actual holdings: concentration, mix and exposure. No model, no market data, and not financial advice.
insights.emptyTitle: Insights need holdings to look at
insights.emptyDescription: Add or import a few positions and the assessment appears here.
insights.scoreExplanation: Starts at 100 and deducts for position concentration (Herfindahl index), a largest holding above 20%, crypto above 15%, and fewer than four asset classes.
insights.footer: Simulated AI insights · demo. Generated by fixed rules from the quantities and prices you entered. Educational only; not investment, tax or financial advice.
